interface.shortDescription: Direct your film with source-grounded creative choices.
interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts is a source-grounded directing workshop, designed to give actionable film/edit/shot decisions from any available idea, script, images, video or sound without a fixed media count. The director-first v0.34 skill cuts engineering chatter and prioritizes one concrete creative intervention, trade-off and cheapest test. Public MCP tools can support file metadata, selected images and unapproved draft state. Real host image perception, external directing quality and verified cross-session memory are not yet certified.
interface.developerName: objekts — film, advertising, AI/VFX & CGI production studio
defaultPrompt: Develop my film idea without requiring images or a script; identify one meaningful directorial choice.
